directFindings: Since cdf45f9, MetalRenderer changes only static acceleration descriptor partitioning and reporting metadata. Its per-frame pass count, ray samples, GPU timing calculation and 8x8 dispatch group remain unchanged.

Renderer.metal changes consist of global primitive ID normalization via geometry_id plus three uint-to-ulong scene vertex index calculations. No additional trace ray or lighting loop was introduced by these edits.

render-inputs.json and final-gpu-batch.json record identical Renderer.metal SHA223e94e5338fd7906e649ef62537de182235ac544c7138f7c19212103a4987df. The faster pre-cap Robie run already used these wide indices and the same GeometryPartition helper.

Therefore ulong indices and descriptor partitioning cannot by themselves explain the later pre-cap-to-final Robie performance change. The v1.8 Field comparison also changes total city geometry and is not a clean single-variable attribution.

The temporal cap adds scalar screen-motion arithmetic, no new dispatch/texture pass/ray count/loop. The spatial filter uses history count only in its final blend strength; it does not gain an extra branch because of this cap.

Controlled copied-app A/B keeps executable, final city, Renderer.metal and partitions identical, changing only bundled Denoise.metal. Field differs by0.57%; the capped flight is3.31%faster than uncapped. This does not support the cap as the major slowdown.

Current copied-app initial pipeline+AS setup took25–38seconds. A sampled stack showed waiting for an AS build before any temporal frame. This cannot be caused by execution of the new temporal arithmetic.
No-cap flight reproduces the temporal-quality regression and exits1; this is an expected ablation failure, not an aborted experiment.
confoundsAndLimits: Root reports the Mac is currently locked; exact historical lock time and GPU clocks are unavailable. Device idle/App Nap/QoS is a hypothesis, not a proven cause.
Root checked ample free memory and no swap; thermal warning and GPU recovery counters did not identify a cause.
Root CPU-only app build may overlap the last no-cap flight. Its overall wall time is not a clean comparison; primary comparison is paired GPU command duration.
These16-frame8spp/64reference measurements isolate performance, not full release temporal quality. Existing32-frame128reference results remain the release quality evidence.
The earlier large dense synthetic AS timeout also has unresolved cause and must not be attributed definitively to geometric arrangement.
